scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend && CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY=0 npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run db:generate:hostinger && npm run db:migrate:hostinger && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:generate:hostinger: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma generate --schema backend/prisma-hostinger/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:hostinger: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate deploy --schema backend/prisma-hostinger/schema.prisma
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend -- --run
